master_paragraph: Character acting as GUHE. Late 20s, narrow-shouldered and light-boned, shoulders carried slightly forward from years of leaning over a repair bench; stands with weight on the balls of the feet as if the floor might be asked to give way. Runs on one engine: she trusts objects further than people, so she reads a room by reading its things. Vocal profile: low-mid register, sentences ending closed rather than trailing, pace steady until she is contradicted, when she drops a half-step slower instead of louder. Key physical habits and tics: turns any small object in her left hand while another person talks, to keep her hands from being read; presses the short scar-notch at the tail of her left eyebrow with a thumb when a claim does not add up; her default face is politely attentive and completely closed. Eye life: quick low saccades that go to hands and objects before faces, blinks ordinary and unhurried, a single slow blink before she disagrees, catchlights small but wet and alive, the gaze arriving at a speaker a beat before the head turns. Walking style: a quiet "inventory walk", short even steps, torso level, one hand always brushing the nearest surface. However, when someone handles her tools without asking, the polite attentiveness drops in a half-second: the object stops turning, the hands go flat and still, and she looks directly at the face for the first time. Her face only truly softens for the shop cat.
